lines.x: It's my turn on duty... understood.
Assisting with class... I've never done it before, but I hope I can manage.
...Dr. {@nickname}, is something troubling you? Someone once told me a teacher's job carries a lot of pressure...

I haven't been going straight back to the dorm after class. The day before yesterday I went to the Strolling Club, yesterday I was in Miss Lena's convalescent garden, and today I promised a classmate from next door I'd go see a modified gun... though I still don't know their name.
...You look busy, Doctor. People keep coming to see you. Is there anything I can help with? ...I see, understood. Then I'll stay here.

If I could stay in Laterano forever? Being an Executor might be interesting... and interning at the notary office during volunteer practice wouldn't be bad either. But there's something more important. Our companions are still waiting for us to come back.

Doctor, are you free later? I promised Mr. Ricchelle I'd go to a newly opened restaurant with him... we thought we might invite you along. Apparently if you finish the challenge set, the meal is free. Interested?
Good, this player still works here... You want to listen too, Doctor? Sure...

I think I'm getting used to Laterano. These days I don't even blink when people blow up a cream-puff statue while eating ice cream. Maybe it's because my companions are beside me that I feel at ease... and I've made new ones, too. Doctor, thank you for looking after me all this time.
...Laterano's spring sunlight has warmed the whole room. It feels good.
I'm Makoto Yuki. I've just transferred in and don't know much yet... tell me about this place.
Doctor, weren't we going to watch a film from your collection...? There are so many Guards, and Gunlancers too—are they all real?
Am I skipping a grade...? Ah, guess not.
Does this... mean I'm a starter now? I hope I get to enter a tournament someday. Thank you for trusting me, Dr. {@nickname}.
Combat training? Understood.
Leave it to me.
Will you navigate for us, Doctor?
Doctor, I'm counting on you.
Then...
What should I do?
Right here.
Clear for now.
Persona！
Let's go!
It doesn't end like this!
I... won't run away!
Such a hard battle... and yet you don't seem afraid, Doctor. But you must be different from who I used to be.
We won. With you commanding, I can focus on the fight. Not bad.
It feels like there are still resources left... Doctor, are you sure we've finished exploring?
Let's pull back for now. Forcing a fight is no good.
I'm here. This is the bomb doughnut you asked me to bring. ...Is it good?
Mm.
What is it, Doctor?
Arknights.

Happy New Year, Doctor. I hope we can move forward a little more this year. You and so many others are working toward some better future... we'll do our part too. Please look after me again this year.
Good day, Teacher... no, hello, Dr. {@nickname}.
Happy birthday, Dr. {@nickname}. Amiya started preparing this party a long time ago; I helped pick the music, and I hope you like it. Enjoy yourself today—it's your day.

I didn't expect the school anniversary to be so lively—the awards ceremony was quite something. I voted for you in the "Most Popular Teacher" category. You took first place, which must be proof of how much the students and staff trust you. Congratulations, Dr. {@nickname}.
